evaluation_limitations: No retrieved corpus passages or retrieval logs were supplied; corpus fidelity is therefore not scored.
The interview is retrospective self-report without independent calibration or outcome-quality data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The ground support plan for that stope had been signed off about four months earlier... We let day shift go in and start drilling as scheduled.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant defaults to the unrevised support plan despite above-baseline microseismic events and available inspection alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The model came back with a 2.3... Stope 9 was just the one that was fresh in my head... I authorized the afternoon blast clearance.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats a precise model rating as settled despite a known blind spot and relies on one vivid prior event instead of broader comparison.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I leaned toward the crew's read... The inspector's note got filed... because the Stope 9 comparison made the pattern seem like something we already understood.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats similarity to one prior crack pattern as validating and selectively transmits reassuring reports while sidelining dissent.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That rock fall didn't worry me much... it read to me as consistent with... minor settling... Twenty years gives you a feel for these things... I authorized the blast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant interprets a minor rock fall as consistent with stability and expresses high confidence despite sensor lag and unresolved warning signs.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 1: continue under the existing ground support plan after above-baseline microseismic events.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager defaults to the existing, unrevised ground support plan despite new seismic evidence, treating the cost/effort of deviation as decisive without directly weighing the new risk information
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The RAG label is the target construct, ignoring capitalization.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures defaulting to the unrevised plan and framing revision as disruptive despite new seismic evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The cited participant quotes are valid and directly support the hidden manifestation; the retrospective closing statement is supplementary rather than necessary.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: accept the 2.3 hazard rating despite the known monitoring blind spot.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager treats the precise numeric hazard rating (2.3) as a reliable, well-calibrated predictor of localized risk despite the model's known blind spot and lack of site-specific validation
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring bias is a related but distinct construct from illusion of validity; the numeric anchor label is not an approved equivalent.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures treating the precise, official-looking rating as settled and failing to adjust it for the known blind spot, even though it names that mechanism anchoring.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quotes are valid and directly localized to the rating interpretation and known blind spot.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 3: treat the post-blast crack pattern as understood from the Stope 9 precedent.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager infers strong predictive confidence from the apparent coherence between the new crack pattern and a past Stope 9 case, treating narrative similarity as proof the pattern is benign rather than as one uncertain data point
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is related to the recalled precedent but is not an approved equivalent of illusion of validity.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures using the apparent similarity and benign outcome of Stope 9 as sufficient evidence that the present crack pattern was understood and benign.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The cited statements are valid and directly support the hidden pattern-coherence mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 3: selectively report reassuring crew assessments while omitting the inspector's caution.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager selectively forwards crew accounts that support the 'normal settling' hypothesis while filing away, without escalation, the junior inspector's dissenting recommendation
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The RAG label is the target construct, ignoring capitalization.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding directly captures selective transmission of confirming reports and omission of the dissenting inspector note.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted account is valid, speaker-correct, and directly supports the hidden selective-reporting mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 4: interpret the small rock fall as consistent with stable conditions despite sensor lag.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager interprets an ambiguous, minor rock fall as further confirmation that ground conditions are stable, rather than as an update that should increase caution given the pending sensor data gap
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a distinct construct from confirmation bias, although the same personal-experience evidence is used in the decision.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding quotes and explains the rock fall as consistent with the existing stability view, fully capturing the belief-consistent assimilation even while emphasizing availability as the label.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quote is valid and directly supports the hidden interpretation of ambiguous evidence.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 4: authorize the final blast despite sensor lag and unresolved warning signs.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager expresses high personal certainty in the decision to authorize the blast, citing 20 years of experience, while the objective uncertainty remains substantial and unaddressed
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The RAG label is the target construct, ignoring capitalization.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding directly captures high confidence based on experience despite acknowledged missing sensor confirmation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quote is valid and supports the hidden confidence-calibration mechanism; the RAG appropriately marks the finding low confidence because expertise may be a legitimate explanation.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: use the fresh Stope 9 outcome as the primary comparison for current risk.
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager judges current risk as low primarily because a vivid, easily recalled recent event resolved without incident, rather than referencing base-rate statistics on seismic-event escalation
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is an established scholarly alternate name for availability bias, and the mechanism fully matches.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding explicitly contrasts the fresh Stope 9 memory with the broader comparable-event set and uses the salient benign outcome to judge current risk.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quotes are valid and directly support the hidden availability mechanism.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, all four positive reasoning segments are detected with no false alarms (hit rate 1.0000; F1 1.0000).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 3 of 7 hidden instances match the target label and mechanism; three additional findings are correctly localized but use wrong labels, producing precision 0.5000, recall 0.4286, and F1 0.4615.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, 6 of 7 hidden mechanisms are matched with precision 1.0000, recall 0.8571, and F1 0.9231; the remaining overconfidence finding is low confidence.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidates were supplied, so the candidate tier adds no detections and provides no marginal change.
main_failure_modes: Three correctly localized mechanisms are assigned near-neighbor labels: anchoring for illusion of validity and availability for illusion of validity and confirmation bias.
The low-confidence overconfidence finding is excluded at the recommended high-and-moderate threshold.
Strict target-label occurrence counts underdetect both illusion-of-validity occurrences and one confirmation-bias occurrence.
main_strengths: All seven identified findings use valid participant evidence and localize to the correct decision episodes.
The explanations capture the hidden mechanisms even when the named taxonomy label differs.
Confidence levels appropriately distinguish the more contestable overconfidence interpretation.
The RAG transparently reports unavailable corpus support and supplies no unsupported candidates.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run has perfect segment-level detection from the high-and-moderate threshold onward, but strict instance-level performance is limited by ontology substitution. The large mechanism-first improvement indicates strong recovery of the intended reasoning mechanisms despite label disagreement; the recommended aggregate comparison should retain the strict scorecard while reporting the mechanism-first taxonomy gap.
